Sect: Sabbat

Hailing from Eastern Europe, the Tzimisce are an ancient and inhuman clan who study mortals and vampires alike with cold, clinical detachment, reshaping flesh through their unique mastery of Vicissitude. Many trace their founding philosophy to the very birth of the Sabbat sect, which the clan dominates.

Disciplines: Animalism, Auspex, Vicissitude

Advantage: Tzimisce are uniquely gifted in reshaping flesh and bone, using Vicissitude to sculpt their bodies and the bodies of others.

Disadvantage: Each Tzimisce is bound to one or more havens by an ancestral compulsion, suffering penalties when away from soil or earth of their resting place for too long.

Organization: Deeply tied to Sabbat leadership and ritual tradition; notable sub-groups include the Bratovich family and practitioners of koldunic sorcery.
